title: Graph decomposition at the integral expectation threshold
exact_target: Are there universal constants k and L such that every graph H on at most n vertices has an edge partition into k fixed pieces $H_i$ whose random-graph containment thresholds $p_c(H_i;n)$ are at most L times the integral expectation threshold q(H;n)?
